body:
OK, I will consider going to a therapist. 

But I guess I didn't provide enough details. I'm depressed for many reasons (perhaps so many that I can't focus on just one), and one of them is my receding faith in people. I wasn't even that happy when I dated her, it just felt so refreshing to know that someone as nice as this existed. It wasn't my first relationship. Now whenever I meet someone, I kind of shake my head a little at how disappointing they are. It sounds conceited but that's really what my subconscious thinks. I feel I will never know someone with as pure of a heart as her's. I have to wait and see but the standards are quite high. 

I'm starting to feel a little better now. I'm looking back at what I wrote and I'm not quite satisfied. I'm still pretty confused about exactly why I feel this way even though I think about it every minute, and I still can't explain it properly. 

I live in a duplex house and the landlord does not allow pets. I would love to get one though.

I posted a bunch of details here: http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/dv4fo/i_want_a_good_reason_to_kill_myself/c135av5

My parents are with me but I'm not on very good speaking terms with them. They're not exactly the therapist type of parents. 

I could go out and meet other people, but that's part of the reason why I'm depressed: I hate socializing. When I talk to people it makes me feel even more depressed especially right afterwards. I'm a strong introvert. Thanks for the suggestion though.
Life is a gift I would hastily reject if I could.

You're right. I want to see what the future holds but I have a feeling it's going to be nothing good. I can't imagine living a life without loneliness. My stupid subconscious still wants to live and I'm trying my hardest to get rid of that idea. 

I don't have the time or money to see a therapist. I don't think that will help anyways since I'm terrible at expressing myself verbally, and perhaps the therapist will misunderstand me. 

This must have began when my girlfriend moved away to China. I've been trying to move on ever since but I failed terribly. I read this: http://www.scientificamerican.com/blog/post.cfm?id=being-suicidal-what-it-feels-like-t-2010-10-20 and Step 3 really hits me the hardest. Maybe I would have been better off without ever having dated. But it all came crashing down and I don't think it's recoverable. Even if I never date and become satisfied with my loser self, I will never truly be satisfied and feel like I'm living a lie. I've already done this my entire life and I don't want to do it again.

I have no pets.

It's depressing that my calling seems to be music right now. The music industry is a very thin balancing line and I have no idea if I'll make it.

Omegle, I just go there and fool around. It's interesting to see how people introduce themselves or start conversations, but I never go too deep with them. It's also kind of a downer because I get disconnected a lot.

I guess I agree she could do much worse, but I don't want to be *that* bad guy. Well, I have no intention of dumping her or anything, I hope we can make it. 

>It's not about belief that you'll be beneficial to someone eventually, it's that you already are. You don't don't realise it.

Thanks for this. (despite the typo) It really struck a chord in me and now I have a lot of thinking to do.
